units.source_text: 无论在红叶馆还是在这里，每次续弈，临场往往出现类似违约的事，

en.t: Whether at the Momiji-kan or here, each time play was resumed, something like a breach of agreement would often arise on the spot,

units.source_text: 可是又没有一个工作人员具有审判官的权威，对名人也能下令和裁决。

en.t: but none of the staff had the authority of a referee who could give orders and make rulings even to the Master.

units.source_text: 七段也担心今后事态的发展。

en.t: The seventh-dan player was also worried about how matters would develop from then on.

units.source_text: 不过他还是干脆顺从了名人，脸上也没怎样露出不悦的神色。

en.t: Still, he simply yielded to the Master, and his face scarcely showed any displeasure.
